items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality for Finite Sums
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ and $N$ be additive commutative monoids, where $N$ is equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any subadditive function $f : M \to N$ satisfying $f(0) \leq 0$, and for any finite set $s$ of indices and function $g : s \to M$, it holds that $f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i))$.

items.informal_name: Sum of Finite Support Functions Preserves Inequality
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] {f : ι →₀ α} {h₁ h₂ : ι → α → β},
  (∀ i ∈ f.support, h₁ i (f i) ≤ h₂ i (f i)) → f.sum h₁ ≤ f.sum h₂
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ M $ in an ordered additive commutative monoid $ M $, if $ h₁(i, f(i)) \leq h₂(i, f(i)) $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ f $, then the sum of $ h₁ $ over $ f $ satisfies $ \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} h₁(i, f(i)) \leq \sum_{i \in \text{supp}(f)} h₂(i, f(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Sum Preserves Strict Inequality for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_3} (m n : ι →₀ ℕ), m < n → (m.sum fun x => id) < n.sum fun x => id
items.informal_description: For any finite support functions $m$ and $n$ from a type $\iota$ to the natural numbers $\mathbb{N}$, if $m < n$ under the pointwise preorder (i.e., $m(i) \leq n(i)$ for all $i$ and $m(i) < n(i)$ for at least one $i$), then the sum of the values of $m$ is strictly less than the sum of the values of $n$. Formally, $\sum_{i \in \iota} m(i) < \sum_{i \in \iota} n(i)$.

items.informal_name: Sum Inequality for Finite Support Functions under Monotonicity
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : Preorder α] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid β]
  [inst_3 : PartialOrder β] [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι] {f₁ f₂ : ι →₀ α} {h : ι → α → β},
  f₁ ≤ f₂ →
    (∀ i ∈ f₁.support ∪ f₂.support, Monotone (h i)) → (∀ i ∈ f₁.support ∪ f₂.support, h i 0 = 0) → f₁.sum h ≤ f₂.sum h
items.informal_description: Let $\iota$ be an index type and $\alpha, \beta$ be types with $\alpha$ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For finite support functions $f_1, f_2 : \iota \to_0 \alpha$ satisfying $f_1 \le f_2$ pointwise, and a family of functions $h_i : \alpha \to \beta$ that are monotone on $\mathrm{supp}(f_1) \cup \mathrm{supp}(f_2)$ with $h_i(0) = 0$, the inequality $\sum h(f_1) \le \sum h(f_2)$ holds, where the sums are taken over the respective supports.

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality on Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) →
      (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) →
        ∀ (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) → f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description:
Let $ M $ and $ N $ be additive commutative monoids with $ N $ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any function $ f : M → N $ satisfying $ f(0) ≤ 0 $, and predicate $ p : M → 	ext{Prop} $ such that:
1. $ f $ is subadditive on $ p $-elements: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ f(x + y) ≤ f(x) + f(y) $,
2. $ p $-elements are closed under addition: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ p(x + y) $,
then for any finite set $ s $ and function $ g : ι → M $ with $ p(g(i)) $ for all $ i ∈ s $, we have:
$$
 f\left(\sum_{i ∈ s} g(i)\right) ≤ \sum_{i ∈ s} f(g(i)).
$$

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality for Non-Empty Finite Sums
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) →
    ∀ {s : Finset ι}, s.Nonempty → ∀ (g : ι → M), f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $ M $ and $ N $ be additive commutative monoids, with $ N $ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any subadditive function $ f : M \to N $ (i.e., $ f(x + y) \leq f(x) + f(y) $ for all $ x, y \in M $), any non-empty finite set $ s $, and any function $ g : s \to M $, it holds that $ f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i)) $.
